newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX, Bell Atlantic rise on merger okay.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX, Bell Atlantic rise on merger okay.

text.p: NYNEX Corp stock jumped and Bell Atlantic Corp rose modestly on news that the Department of Justice approved their $23 billion merger.

NYNEX quickly added $1-1/8, to stand $1 up at $45-1/2 while Bell Atlantic was 1/4 higher at $60, reversing earlier losses. The deal is an exchange of 0.768 Bell Atlantic shares for every NYNEX share, which if Bell Atlantic stands at $60 would value NYNEX at just over $46.
"One thing you can say is that the spread between the two stocks will certainly narrow," said Guy Woodlief, an analyst at Prudential Research.

NYNEX stock had underperformed the planned value in terms of Bell Atlantic stock by as much as 3.5 percentage points in recent weeks, reflecting swirling uncertainty about whether the Justice Department would raise objections, analysts say.
Trading volume in both stocks remained moderate by 1530 EDT/2030 GMT.

The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is the only hurdle left for the merger. The FCC must approve the transfer of the cellular licenses NYNEX has to Bell Atlantic, but it is not expected to be a difficult approval to gain, analysts say.
"We expect approval in a matter of weeks after the FCC license transfer decision," Woodlief said.

Total approval will mean that the seven regional Bells created by the 1984 break-up of Ma Bell have become five within a year of the U.S. Telecommunications Act which allowed Bell and long distance firms into each others' markets.
SBC Communications Inc completed its purchase of Pacific Telesis Group on April 1. (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712))
